learning_outcomes.text: Explain how social media fits an organisation's marketing and goals
Set audience-based strategy, platform choices and objectives
Plan content, formats and a publishing calendar
Build and manage an engaged community
Measure performance, handle issues and iterate

integrative_case: A mid-size outdoor-gear retailer wants to grow an engaged community rather than just followers. Set social objectives tied to business goals, choose platforms and content pillars, build a publishing and engagement plan, define community guidelines and a response approach, and select the metrics that show real engagement and impact.
